meta.source: Blizzard Game Data journal-encounter + Wowhead tooltip API
meta.readMe: Ability text and damage magnitudes come from Wowhead's tooltip endpoint, which is the only source carrying tuned numbers for this tier -- Blizzard's /data/wow/spell/<id> returns 404 for these ids and the in-game journal text ships 'X' placeholders. A magnitude here is ONE difficulty's value and the endpoint does not say which; cross-check against measured damage taken in profiles/<spec>-<difficulty>.json before quoting it as a Mythic number.

encounter.name: Nek'zali the Soulcoiler
encounter.description: Long ago, the shadow hunter Nek'zali and her followers were entombed for the blasphemous act of summoning Ula'tek. Restored by the very power she unleashed, she calls the other Soulcoilers from their tombs to serve her once more.

notes.title: Overview
notes.bodyText:
As Nek'zali energizes the [Soulcoil Well] by invoking the [Soulcoil Rite], she provokes the [Restless Amani] to the well. 

Upon reaching 50% health, Nek'zali retreats to begin the [Ritual of Awakening]. Destroying Echoes of Jawae removes their [Tethers of Awakening] and draws her back. 

Upon reaching full energy, she unwinds the Soulcoil and begins [Uncoiling], empowering her with new abilities until her defeat.

notes.title: Damage Dealers
notes.bodyText:
$bullet; [Essence Rend] lingers and leaves behind a [Latent Cultist] upon expiration.
$bullet; [Restless Amani] awaken from the sarcophagi on the outer edges of the room, empowered with [Gravebound Advance] until they are destroyed.
$bullet;  Echoes of Jawae awaken during [Soul Transfer] and provide Nek'zali with [Tether of Awakening].

notes.title: Restless Amani
notes.bodyText: Ancient spirits return to their corpses, and make their way towards the [Soulcoil Well].

notes.title: Intermission: Ritual of Awakening
notes.bodyText: Upon reaching 50% health, Nek'zali retreats to the Soulcoil Well and summons an Echo of Jawae that protects her from harm.

notes.title: Echo of Jawae
notes.bodyText: A spectral echo that protects Nek'zali from harm. Defeating an Echo of Jawae severs their Tether of Awakening.
bullets: A spectral echo that protects Nek'zali from harm. Defeating an Echo of Jawae severs their Tether of Awakening.

notes.title: Stage Two: Uncoiling
notes.bodyText: Nek'zali uncoils the Soulcoil Well, gaining new abilities until defeated.
bullets: Nek'zali uncoils the Soulcoil Well, gaining new abilities until defeated.

abilities.title: Soulcoil Well
abilities.description:
A well of necrotic energy used to raise the cult of the Soulcoilers. Any Restless Amani that reach the well trigger a Soulcoil Rite.

Standing in the well inflicts 125011 Shadow damage every 1 sec. Players who die within the well are Soulcoiled.

abilities.title: Soulcoil Rite
abilities.description: The Soulcoil Well churns, granting Nek'zali 5 energy. Inflicts 66673 Shadow damage to all players and an additional 20835 Shadow damage every 2 sec for 44 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Ritual Burn
abilities.description: Increases damage taken from Soulcoil Rite by 15% for 1 min. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Uncoiled Rage
abilities.description: Upon reaching full energy, Nek'zali gains her full potential, increasing her attack and movement speeds by 150% and all damage by 500%. Additionally, grants immunity to Taunt effects.

abilities.title: Soulcoiled
abilities.description: Nek'zali claims a player's soul, compelling them towards the Soulcoil Well. The target is sacrificed upon reaching its waters, triggering Soulcoil Rite.

abilities.title: Soulcoil Ignition
abilities.description: Nek'zali stirs the Soulcoil Well, invoking the Soulcoil Rite every 1 sec for 4 sec. During the channel, Anguished Echoes emerge from the well.

abilities.title: Anguished Echoes
abilities.description: An anguished spirit emerges, inflicting 500044 Shadow damage to players within 5 yards of its impact location and knocking them away.

abilities.title: Essence Rend
abilities.description:
Nek'zali entraps several players, pulling them in for 5 sec before knocking them away and inflicting 166681 Shadow damage.

A ghostly essence remains, inflicting 66673 Shadow damage every 1 sec for 15 sec. Upon removal, a Latent Cultist emerges at the player's location.

abilities.title: Latent Cultist
abilities.description: A cultist's spirit materializes, inflicting 541714 Shadow damage to players within 6 yards. Necrotic energy clings to the spirit, inflicting 275024 Shadow damage every 1 sec and reducing movement speed of players standing within it by 40%.

abilities.title: Vessel of Awakening
abilities.description: A corpse lingers on the ground to be repossessed by Restless Amani while the Ritual of Awakening is active. Reawakened Amani become empowered, inflicting 125011 Shadow damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

abilities.title: Gravebound Advance
abilities.description: Restless Amani are protected by a necrotic barrier, absorbing magic damage equal to 25% of their maximum health. While the barrier holds, the Restless Amani cannot be destroyed and fixate on the Soulcoil Well.

abilities.title: Corpse Blight
abilities.description: Restless Amani erupt in necrosis, inflicting 20835 Plague damage to all players and an additional 1667 Plague damage every 1 sec for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Possession Barrage
abilities.description: Nek'zali launches spectral echoes in the direction of her primary target that burst on impact, inflicting 291692 Shadow damage to all players. This damage is reduced the farther each echo travels.

abilities.title: Hollowing Strikes
abilities.description: Nek'zali's melee attacks tear away a part of the target's soul, inflicting 16668 Shadow damage every 3 sec and reducing healing and absorption effects received by 5% for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Soul Transfer
abilities.description: Jawae transfers her essence to an Echo of Jawae over 15 sec. A surge of soul energy then inflicts 666725 Shadow damage to players caught in the blast.

abilities.title: Tether of Awakening
abilities.description: Tethered to the Soulcoil Well, gaining immunity to all damage.

abilities.title: Hungering Pyre
abilities.description: The Echo of Jawae erupts in soul fire, inflicting 5000440 Fire damage split evenly between players within 10 yards. Slithering Flames seek out players who are not hit by the pyre.

abilities.title: Slithering Flame
abilities.description: A serpentine flame slithers to a player and ignites, inflicting 250022 Fire damage and an additional 41670 Fire damage every 1 sec for 20 sec.

abilities.title: Cremation
abilities.description: The flames explode, incinerating corpses and Restless Amani within 4 yards. Inflicts 125011 Fire damage to players and an additional 25002 Fire damage every 1 sec for 20 sec.

abilities.title: Grasping Depths
abilities.description: A Drowned Echo awakens within the well, periodically pulling players towards the well and inflicting 8334 Shadow damage every 1 sec to all players until it is defeated. Players may enter the well while the echo lives, and are marked with Soul Exhaustion upon leaving.

abilities.title: Immortal Coil
abilities.description: Necrotic energy within the well inflicts 58338 Shadow damage every 1 sec.

abilities.title: Soulcoiler's Curse
abilities.description: The Drowned Echo coils around all players within the well, ejecting them and leaving them Soulcoiled.

abilities.title: Swirling Spirit
abilities.description: Spirits swirl within the Soulcoil Well, inflicting 66673 Shadow damage every 1 sec for 5 sec on contact. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Soul Exhaustion
abilities.description: The Soulcoil Well marks those who leave it, increasing damage taken from Soulcoil Well and Immortal Coil by 300%.

abilities.title: Uncoiling
abilities.description: Nek'zali pours all her power into the Soulcoil Well, causing it to overflow, energizing her and inflicting 8334 Shadow damage every 0.9 sec until she is defeated.

abilities.title: Invoke
abilities.description: Nek'zali invokes the Soulcoil Rite and calls upon the Latent Cultists to perform an Entwined Step.

abilities.title: Entwined Step
abilities.description: Latent Cultists reenact an ancient ritual, repositioning around the Soulcoil Well.
